notes:
aurora_lint 1504 (v0.5.3 step 3), MSC01-C batch 1 of 3: valkey baseline, plus the 5 new MSC01-C keys aurora_lint 1535 surfaced. valkey had no MSC01-C labels. Held until aurora_lint 1535 (EXP19-C/MSC01-C comment-as-body and spliced-chain fix, d2453457) landed, then released by the coordinator. Stacked on the previous 1504 branch off benchmark_adjudication main 157bd9b; this branch adds only this batch's rows over its parent.

POPULATION. Postgres realworld run 274 (aurora-lint 05bd14f9) unlabeled in-scope valkey MSC01-C keys (401), diffed against main. A local probe at d2453457 (MSC01-C + EXP19-C only, via bench.realworld_runner._build_sqc_cmd, corpus-check clean; a diagnostic, not a project figure) shows 1535 removes none of them, so all 401 are labeled; split by file into three batches. This batch also carries the 5 keys 1535 ADDED in other corpora (reported at d2453457 and absent at run 274; dev-468's A/B on 1535): mbedtls library/ssl_tls12_server.c:3732 and library/x509_crt.c:1047, curl lib/cf-socket.c:706 and lib/http.c:683, sqlite src/trigger.c:364. They are labeled ahead of the next official run, which will report them.

STANDARD. The existing MSC01-C convention (~2,400 labels, ~95% FP): FP when the missing final else or default is the intentional no-op or fall-through of a guard-clause, error-check or optional-behaviour idiom, when values are handled by code after the chain, or when the chain covers every possible value; TP when a dispatch over an enumeration, state or mode set leaves legitimate values silently unhandled with no fallback. A switch or chain over a bitfield or mask wider than its declared enumerators, with no default and no fallback, is TP at medium, matching the sel4 notification/endpoint/vspace labels. Config-gated arms count as written (ADR-0010).

METHOD. One read-only agent per batch, briefed with the convention above, with every TP and flagged call spot-checked at source by the adjudicator.

RESULT: 135 FP / 0 TP.
- The 5 new keys are real else-if chains whose tail is at the flagged line, now that the chain is followed across comments and #if/#endif. All FP: error-check idioms (ssl_tls12_server.c:3732, x509_crt.c:1047), an address-family dispatch where af is only AF_INET/AF_INET6 (cf-socket.c:706, medium), an auth-scheme chain whose remaining cases are handled by the following if/else (http.c:683), and an IN_RENAME_OBJECT chain whose init.busy case is handled just after (trigger.c:364).
- Medium FPs: debug.c:1205 (debug-log type chain under UNSAFE_CRASH_REPORT); module.c:4180 (the repl_state chain sets IS_CONNECTING/TRANSFERRING/ONLINE per the flags valkeymodule.h:205-206 documents, and handshake states get only REPLICA_IS_STALE; closest to a TP in the batch).
- No misfires.

Counting basis: distinct (project, commit, file, line, rule) keys. No precision/recall claim is made here.
